personality_one_liner: A cinematic, expensive, and deeply textured workspace where raw ideas are effortlessly transformed into premium branded assets.

spacing.rule: Generous, editorial spacing. Ensure components feel cinematic with ample breathing room. One element should dominate the screen. Safe area must be strictly respected. Primary CTAs pinned to bottom.

do's: Use intense blur with a ≥75% translucent tinted base under text to guarantee readability.
Apply glass effects to bottom tab bar, sticky headers, and full-screen modal scrims.
Apply glass over abstract dark textures for hero cards to create depth.
dont's: Never blur body text regions, form fields, or standard list rows.
Never layer glass on top of glass; keep it to one or two elevated surfaces per screen.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A premium cinematic hub highlighting quick-start actions and celebrating creator milestones.

states.loading: Centered sleek spinner using brandPrimary color.
states.empty: N/A - Dashboard always has quick-start actions.
states.error: Elegant error banner with a soft retry button.

screens.layout: Hero section featuring an abstract glass texture background with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Large, elegant 'Fraunces' greeting. Below the fold, a sleek horizontal scrolling list of quick-start actions (Voice Memo, New Brand Kit) inside glassmorphic cards. A 'Milestone Tracker' section with a premium gold visual.

screens.name: Incubator
screens.purpose: A sophisticated workspace for capturing ideas via text or voice and refining them through AI.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders with slow, premium shimmer effects.
states.empty: A stylized creative studio background illustration, faded, with a primary floating action button to capture an idea.
states.error: Subtle red-tinted glassmorphism card explaining the issue with a primary retry CTA.

screens.layout: List of active projects using large, high-contrast cards. A floating action button (FAB) for Voice/Text capture pinned with glass effect. Detail screen: conversational refinement layout resembling an elegant, sparse editorial document rather than a noisy chat app. Sticky bottom input bar with glass background.

screens.name: Branding Studio
screens.purpose: A luxurious asset generator showcasing brand kits, swatches, and high-fidelity mockups.

states.loading: Abstract brand color pulse indicating AI generation.
states.empty: Textural dark background prompting the user to create their first Brand Kit.
states.error: Error message with a muted warning palette and retry generation.

screens.layout: Grid of Brand Kits. Within a kit: Swatches represented as oversized circular pills or rounded squares without borders. Asset preview tiles (logos, social graphics) are large, full-width cards using `surfaceSecondary` or glass on dark backgrounds. A sticky primary CTA 'Generate Assets' at the bottom. The layout must feel like a premium moodboard.

screens.name: Paywall
screens.purpose: Converts users via an ultra-premium, cinematic subscription showcase.

states.loading: Dark overlay with an elegant brand loader.

screens.layout: Full-bleed atmospheric dark glass background. An oversized, serif headline. Two pricing tiers displayed as sleek, selectable cards with `brandTertiary` background when selected. A sticky `brandPrimary` Continue button at the bottom. No visual clutter, purely focused on the premium upgrade proposition.

hero_background.alt: Abstract dark glass texture for premium hero section

studio_empty_state.alt: Creative minimal studio workspace for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Fraunces' and 'Geist' fonts locally via expo-font using provided TTF assets. Do not use expo-google-fonts.

Implement the 'Glass / Luxe DARK' personality as the default theme. Do not invert colors blindly for light mode; use the provided 'light_mode_colors' mapping which retains a premium, high-contrast editorial feel.

Strictly follow the gradient scrim rule: Any text sitting over the `hero_background` MUST have a vertical expo-linear-gradient behind it (transparent at 0% to ≥75% surfaceInverse at 100%) to ensure text contrast.
Never use indigo, violet, blue, or purple in any UI element. Rely on the Antique Gold (`brandPrimary`) and Charcoal (`surface`) palette.
Apply subtle Haptics on all major interactions (Primary CTA, Tab changes, generating brand assets). Serialize via the haptics block.
For the Incubator refinement screen, design it like an editorial document, not a chat app. The AI responses should feel like a premium tool generating text block by block.
Ensure all primary buttons are pinned to the bottom (thumb zone) inside a fixed container avoiding the safe area, avoiding scroll interference.
Include a 'Surprises' or milestone unlock animation using `react-native-confetti-cannon` or similar, triggering on hitting a tracker goal.
